description: Map our events and selections to a bookmaker's own event, market and outcome ids (for example Polymarket conditionId and token id, or Kalshi tickers), joinable to get_odds on (eventId, market, hdp, side). Look up by eventId(s), marketId(s) or outcomeId; with none of these it is a bulk sync of upcoming and live events, paged with cursor until nextCursor is null. Paid plans; the bookmaker must be in the key's selection.

active.description: true or false; both when omitted

cursor.description: Bulk sync only: nextCursor from the previous page

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

league.description: Bulk sync only: league slug, requires sport

limit.description: Bulk sync only: rows per page, 1-5000 (default 1000)

market.description: Exact market name as in get_odds, case-sensitive

marketIds.description: Up to 10 comma-separated bookmaker market ids

outcomeId.description: The bookmaker's outcome id (for Kalshi pass marketId too)

name: get_mappings
title: Bookmaker id mappings
